errors.network: Unable to connect. Please try again later.

errors.identity: Administrator identity service is not connected yet.
errors.unauthenticated: Sign in to access the administration workspace.
errors.forbidden: This account cannot access the administration workspace.

notFound.title: This page is unavailable

contribution.title: My storage contributions
contribution.description: Choose how much space to share and for how long. Track usage and request a pause or exit.
contribution.adminDescription: Review contribution status, capacity and migration progress. Retry blocked tasks.
contribution.accepted: Request accepted; storage confirmation is pending. Refresh to check the actual state.
contribution.partial: Some observations are stale and excluded from available capacity.
contribution.noOptions: No storage is available to select. Authorized storage will appear here; this page does not accept passwords.
contribution.termRange: Duration: {min} to {max} hours from now. Renewal must extend the current end date.
contribution.invalidForm: Check capacity, reserve and dates, and accept the current terms.
contribution.confirmHint: The server checks current permissions and conditions. Changes take effect after storage confirmation.
contribution.exitHint: Exit cannot be cancelled. Files migrate, and completion requires all replicas and reservations to be cleared.
contribution.revokeHint: Revocation requests stop storage use. Remaining replicas show unconfirmed cleanup; recovery requires reauthorization.
contribution.adminHint: Retry preserves the user’s quota, term, consent and requested state.
contribution.uncertain: The result is unconfirmed. Retry the original request to avoid duplicate changes.
contribution.unknown: Status unavailable. Refresh or contact an administrator.

reasons.storage_conflict: Storage state conflict. Refresh and review.
reasons.binding_unavailable: Storage binding unavailable; administrator review required.
reasons.storage_writes_disabled: Storage is not accepting new files.
reasons.exit_overdue: Exit target passed; migration is still pending.

errors.conflict: State changed or operation conditions are unmet. Refresh and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot perform this operation.
errors.incompatible: The service data format is incompatible. Update and retry.
errors.unauthenticated: Sign in through the platform first.
errors.unavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

custody.title: Storage accounts
custody.description: Connect an account, then choose contribution capacity and duration separately. Credential updates preserve the dedicated folder and contribution conditions.
custody.adminDescription: Review custody requests and resume existing operations. Administrators cannot consent for users or read passwords.
custody.uncertain: The submission result is uncertain. The password was cleared from the form. Look up the original request before creating another.
custody.ssoNotice: For single sign-on, you authorize custody of your university password solely to sign in to BHpan again. It is encrypted until consent expires, is revoked, or the credential is replaced.
custody.consent: I consent to credential custody for this purpose and expiry. Storage contribution needs separate consent.
custody.invalid: Check the account, password, expiry and custody consent.

reasons.authorization_rejected: Authorization was rejected. Check credentials or verification requirements.
reasons.dependency_unavailable: The provider or a required service is unavailable.
reasons.result_unknown: The remote result is unknown. Only the original dedicated folder may be reconciled.
reasons.conflict: The account is already registered or the record changed. Refresh and review.
reasons.attempts_exhausted: The retry limit was reached. Administrator action is required.
reasons.credentials_required: No recoverable credential was saved. Submit credentials again.

custody.adminUncertain: The operation result is uncertain. Resume the original request with the same consent and conditions.
